title: Gallery
intro_md: Real output, nothing mocked up: PSP scenes drawn by Phobos at four times the PSP's resolution, screenshots and screen recordings from a Retroid Pocket 6, and the desktop program on Linux.

groups.title: In motion
groups.intro_md: PSP games drawn at 4x (1920x1088) by Vulkan (fast), each from a saved scene in Phobos's headless runner. No sound; press play.

groups.title: On a Retroid Pocket 6

groups.title: 266 games
groups.alt: A wall of 266 small screenshots, one from each game of the PSP test library: title screens, menus and gameplay
groups.intro_md: Every game of the PSP test library, from boot in the headless runner: one frame each from its first minute. The [compatibility report](https://github.com/pwnedbygary/phobos/blob/master/docs/psp-compatibility.md) names them all and says how far each gets.
